tenets.name: legacy-monolith-app
tenets.functionality: Legacy monolith modernization target. Inbound requests are routed, authenticated, authorised and served from the data layer; every flow here is mapped as intent so it can be tested and modernised without reading the raw syntax.
open_unknowns: Whether the batch reporting jobs are in scope for the first modernization pass.
Which flows are still reachable from the legacy admin UI.

tenets.name: src/api
tenets.functionality: Everything under src/api: API Request Router.

tenets.name: API Request Router
tenets.functionality: Routes inbound HTTP requests and requires a validated session for protected paths.

tenets.name: src/auth
tenets.functionality: Everything under src/auth: Validate Session Token; Refresh Session Token; Role Permission Check.

tenets.name: Validate Session Token
tenets.functionality: Cryptographic signature check before DB lookup.

tenets.name: Refresh Session Token
tenets.functionality: Issues a new short-lived token from a valid refresh token.

tenets.name: Role Permission Check
tenets.functionality: Grants access when the user's role covers the requested action.

tenets.name: src/db
tenets.functionality: Everything under src/db: Database User Lookup.

tenets.name: Database User Lookup
tenets.functionality: Queries read-replica Postgres with permission cache TTL.

tenets.name: src/security
tenets.functionality: Everything under src/security: Security Audit Logger.

tenets.name: Security Audit Logger
tenets.functionality: Emits security telemetry for invalid signature events.

tenets.name: tests
tenets.functionality: Everything under tests: Deterministic Test Suite.

tenets.name: Deterministic Test Suite
tenets.functionality: Generated tests enforce the mapped business boundaries.

tenets.name: infra
tenets.functionality: Everything under infra: PostgreSQL Primary; Redis Invariant Cache; Kafka Event Bus.

tenets.name: PostgreSQL Primary
tenets.functionality: Users and role grants isolated behind the connection pool.

tenets.name: Redis Invariant Cache
tenets.functionality: TTL: 300s session token; instant purge on 401.

api_request_router.c1.statement: Protected routes never execute a handler before session validation succeeds.
api_request_router.c1.test_explanation: Checks the business rule above holds for API Request Router. It matters because routes inbound HTTP requests and requires a validated session for protected paths.
api_request_router.c1.test_implementation:
ENV/SETUP: Python 3.11 in a throwaway copy of the legacy repo (read-only original). No network.
FIXTURES: minimal in-memory stand-ins for every dependency of api_request_router (validate_session, permission_check); literal data only.
INVOKE: call the entry point in src/api/router.py with: request = Incoming HTTP request with path, method and headers.
ASSERT: Protected routes never execute a handler before session validation succeeds.
EXPECTED: result matches the declared output: response = HTTP response from the matched handler.
TEARDOWN: delete the temp copy and reset fixtures.
PASS WHEN: the assertion holds for every fixture case.
FAIL WHEN: any case violates the assertion, or an unexpected exception escapes.
INCONCLUSIVE WHEN: a fixture cannot be built, or the entry point is ambiguous.

area_src_auth.integration.statement: The flows in src/auth compose correctly: Validate Session Token, Refresh Session Token, Role Permission Check hand off in dependency order with no step skipped.
area_src_auth.integration.test_explanation: Integration claim. It only runs once its children's locked invariants pass, so a failure here points at the composition, not a child.
area_src_auth.integration.test_implementation:
ENV/SETUP: same sandbox as the child recipes.
FIXTURES: reuse the child fixtures; share one request context across steps.
ORDER: run each child recipe first, in dependency order (validate_session -> refresh_session -> permission_check).
INVOKE: drive one end-to-end call through src/auth.
ASSERT: every step is reached in order and the final output equals the last child's declared output.
EXPECTED: no step is skipped and no child invariant is violated.
TEARDOWN: reset the shared context.
PASS WHEN: all children pass and the end-to-end call matches.
FAIL WHEN: all children pass but the end-to-end call does not.
INCONCLUSIVE WHEN: any child result is stale or missing.
LOCALIZE: if a child fails, report 'blocked by child failure'. If every child passes and this fails, the fault is in the composition.
